name: Odisee University of Applied Sciences
summary: University of applied sciences in Brussels, Ghent, Aalst and Sint-Niklaas; one English bachelor's: Business Management (Marketing), in Brussels.

handoff.label: Odisee's English-taught bachelor's on Study in Flanders

ib.text: In January 2025: a diploma giving access to higher education at home, and English at B2; an IB taught fully in English (or bilingual) exempts you from a test. 2027 criteria not yet confirmed.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Management – Marketing
programmes.about: A professional business management bachelor with a marketing major, taught in English on the Brussels campus, with advanced English and a second language of your choice (French, Spanish, German or Dutch) at your own level.
programmes.ib: Courses include advanced English plus French, Spanish, German or Dutch at your level. Every new student sits an on-campus English test in October.
programmes.selectionNote: Last published criteria (January 2025): a diploma giving access to higher education at home and B2 English, with no selection stated. 2027 not yet confirmed.

notes: Odisee's other bachelor's are taught in Dutch, with their own admission rules.
Odisee's programme and admission pages sit behind a security check; confirm the 2027 details there before you apply.
